title: HTC Vive Eagle smart glasses review: useful controls, lightweight, and focused on privacy, but inessential, expensive at $499+, and imaging needs to improve (Daniel Cooper/Engadget)
summary: Daniel Cooper / Engadget: HTC Vive Eagle smart glasses review: useful controls, lightweight, and focused on privacy, but inessential, expensive at $499+, and imaging needs to improve — HTC can't win on price, and can't win on the arguments. … Meta makes so much money that it can burn billions upon billions …
